notes:
The Catalog page sees every preview and shows where the footage lives, and the Rich lane stops crashing on a full card
- **Catalog page previews.** A clip's central row now learns its catalog
  home on every preview build, not only when the marker was planted, and the
  page heals rows that still lack one from the folder itself — so sheets
  built earlier show without a rebuild, and "already have one" and "no
  preview" can no longer both be true of the same clip. "On an archive
  drive" now means an archive project, not any clip with a catalog root.
- **"Everything ever shot" has an inside.** Drives and folders from the
  paths the library already stores, one level per expand; click a folder to
  see just that footage, dismiss the chip to widen back.
- **Rich describe on a crowded card.** Before loading a Qwen rung the app
  asks Ollama to release its brain, reads free card memory, and degrades
  within Qwen if the pin does not fit. One child death stands the lane down
  with a Retry in the queue tray; held clips are never counted as done, and
  the completion line says how many were not described.
- **Your model pick reaches the child.** The app resolves the Rich model and
  sends it with each clip; the describe child rereads settings when the file
  changes; the Usage panel names the model actually on the card with its
  measured size, and says when Settings now pick a different one.
- **GPU lanes side by side** (Analysis → Advanced, off by default). On, a
  second lane joins the card only when free memory covers it; off is one
  lane at a time, exactly as before.
- **Faster Signals, quieter backups.** Shot detection no longer re-probes a
  clip it was already handed frames for (11.6 s → 0.6 s on a 6 s 4K clip); a
  sidecar rewritten several times in a burst is mirrored once.
- **Idle models let go sooner.** A lane's idle clock is no longer re-armed by
  the CPU lanes' backlog, and a release waits for the holder's clip to end,
  not its whole run.
- **Two crash paths closed.** A closed Catalog page stayed subscribed to the
  index run and kept launching database workers, including at quit; a window
  closed within a quarter second still started the Resolve worker and every
  lane behind its own teardown.
- Also since 1.3.10: the summaries wait for the analysis lanes; Cmd-Z takes
  back library removes and flags from Activity; the crash-safe requeue asks
  before queuing older clips' work; Pause all stops the ffmpeg lanes
  mid-clip; the tray headline counts jobs and clips separately; the app
  ships Inter as its text font.
added: Time of day sync, for lining up a whole day of cameras.
Tech stack, which scans this computer and tunes itself.
Ingest is a page, so several cards can land at once.
The assistant says what it knows, and every line has a switch.
